regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in semiconductors and AI infrastructure, led by MU, PLTR, MSFT and NVDA across operating, institutional and attention channels; healthcare signals are narrower and more event-dependent. With no completed outcomes in the desk record, conviction remains deliberately modest [track_record].
regime_read_zh: 当前信号主要集中在半导体与AI基础设施，MU、PLTR、MSFT和NVDA获得经营、机构及关注度等多类渠道共同支持；医疗信号较窄，且更依赖事件。鉴于策略尚无已完成评分的历史案例，整体置信度保持克制 [track_record]。

theses.thesis: MU has the cleanest non-extended alignment: purchases by three congressional members, strongly positive insider activity, a large patent cluster and uniformly bullish retail sentiment coincide while 60-day relative performance remains negative [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. The approaching earnings date creates a near-term check on whether the measured activity reflects improving fundamentals.
theses.thesis_zh: MU是当前最清晰、且尚未过度上涨的多渠道共振标的：三名国会议员的净买入、显著为正的内部人活动、大规模专利集群及一致偏多的散户情绪同时出现，而其60日相对表现仍为负 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。临近财报将很快检验这些异常活动是否对应基本面改善。
second_order: AMAT — memory-capacity investment would support semiconductor-equipment demand [patent_cluster]
AI memory and high-bandwidth-memory supply chain — stronger MU demand would imply continued accelerator-memory intensity [insider_mspr]
theses.dissent: The government grant is small and only modestly accelerating, while bullish media and retail channels may duplicate the same sentiment rather than represent independent information [cnbc_pick] [stocktwits_bull].

falsifier.text: The next earnings release shows no improvement in memory demand or outlook while insider MSPR returns to zero or below.

theses.thesis: PLTR combines sharply accelerating federal-contract activity with a uniformly bullish analyst cluster and strong retail attention, providing both operating and market-interest confirmation [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]. Its disclosed political and fund relationships broaden the influence graph but are supporting evidence rather than the core thesis [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood].
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR同时出现联邦合同明显加速、分析师一致偏多以及较强散户关注，经营数据与市场兴趣形成交叉确认 [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]。披露的政治人物及基金关联扩大了影响力网络，但仅作为辅助证据，而非核心逻辑 [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。
second_order: MSFT — government AI adoption can increase demand for secure cloud and model infrastructure [gov_contract_accel]
Federal AI-software integrators — broader agency deployment would create implementation and data-integration work [gov_contract_accel]
theses.dissent: The pack records a politically linked sell-side signal, and the bullish analyst and retail readings could reverse together if contract acceleration fails to persist [trump] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz].

falsifier.text: The next contract update shows federal awards decelerating and the analyst-upgrade cluster disappears.

theses.thesis: NVDA shows six-channel breadth without being extended: analyst optimism, developer activity, patents, special-situation flow and retail attention align with disclosed holdings by several political actors [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [special_situation] [retail_buzz] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. The operating signal is less direct than PLTR's contract acceleration, so conviction stops at medium.
theses.thesis_zh: NVDA具备六类渠道的广度且尚未过度上涨：分析师乐观、开发者活动、专利、特殊情形资金流和散户关注，与多名政治人物披露的持仓同时出现 [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [special_situation] [retail_buzz] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]。由于经营层面的直接信号弱于PLTR的合同加速，因此置信度止于中等。
second_order: MU — accelerator growth increases demand for high-performance memory [github_momentum]
AMAT — sustained AI-chip capacity investment supports semiconductor-equipment demand [patent_cluster]
MSFT — expanding accelerator deployment supports cloud AI capacity [special_situation]
theses.dissent: Several channels are attention or affiliation signals rather than direct demand measures, leaving the thesis exposed if developer and analyst enthusiasm is not followed by operating acceleration [retail_buzz] [affiliation] [analyst_upgrade_cluster].

falsifier.text: The next evidence refresh shows analyst support weakening and developer momentum declining without a new operating-demand signal.

theses.thesis: MSFT's app demand, developer momentum and patent activity align with a favorable political-transaction signal and its factual OpenAI partnership, linking consumer reach, ecosystem activity and AI distribution [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [trump] [actor:Sam Altman]. The stock is not formally extended, though its positive relative performance reduces entry asymmetry.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT的应用需求、开发者动能和专利活动，与偏正面的政治交易信号及其与OpenAI的事实合作关系形成共振，连接了消费者触达、生态活跃度和AI分发能力 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [trump] [actor:Sam Altman]。该股尚未被标记为过度上涨，但较强的相对表现降低了入场的不对称性。
second_order: NVDA — additional cloud AI capacity implies continued accelerator demand [github_momentum]
MU — AI-cloud expansion raises demand for server and accelerator memory [app_demand]
Enterprise AI software ecosystem — broader Microsoft distribution can lift complementary applications and services [actor:Sam Altman]
theses.dissent: App reviews, GitHub activity and patents measure ecosystem breadth but do not establish incremental monetization, while the stock has already outperformed SPY materially over 60 days [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster].

falsifier.text: App demand and developer momentum both decline in the next refresh while no incremental AI monetization signal appears.

theses.thesis: AMAT's congressional buying, patent activity and broad analyst support converge after substantial relative underperformance, creating a contrarian equipment-cycle setup [congress_cluster] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]. Options activity adds attention but is ambiguous because the reported put-call ratio is slightly above one [unusual_options].
theses.thesis_zh: AMAT在明显跑输市场后，同时出现国会议员买入、专利活动和广泛分析师支持，形成逆向的半导体设备周期机会 [congress_cluster] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]。期权活动增加了关注度，但由于认沽认购比略高于1，其方向并不明确 [unusual_options]。
second_order: MU — renewed fabrication-equipment spending would be consistent with improving memory-capex expectations [analyst_upgrade_cluster]
Semiconductor equipment suppliers — a broader fab-spending recovery would lift adjacent process and inspection demand [patent_cluster]
theses.dissent: The options signal is not clearly bullish, and severe relative weakness may reflect a genuine capital-spending slowdown rather than an overlooked opportunity [unusual_options].

falsifier.text: Analyst support weakens while customer capital-spending indicators continue to deteriorate through the next two evidence updates.

theses.thesis: MRK has event-driven alignment across Phase 3 starts, an FDA label-expansion signal, a special situation and a favorable political-transaction signal [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation] [trump]. However, four clinical halts and already-strong relative performance make this a watchlist setup pending clearer clinical confirmation.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK在III期试验启动、FDA标签扩展、特殊情形及偏正面的政治交易信号之间形成事件驱动型共振 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation] [trump]。但四项临床暂停以及已经较强的相对表现意味着应先列入观察名单，等待更清晰的临床确认。
second_order: ABBV — broader large-pharma pipeline interest may extend to peers with Phase 3 and label-expansion activity [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion]
Clinical-trial services — sustained late-stage study starts imply supporting demand for trial execution and data services [clinical_phase3_start]
theses.dissent: The four clinical halts are the strongest hard counter-signal and could outweigh the number of trial starts if they affect important programs [clinical_phase3_start].

falsifier.text: Additional clinical halts emerge or the indicated FDA label expansion fails to progress.
